text:
Alex: quick design review: vector preview + batch import + export flow. mainly copy and keyboard access. screenshot + interaction notes attached.
Priya: Nice start. First impression: table header is noisy. Suggest collapsing metadata into a kebab menu per row.
Jo: Copy: change CTA from 'Export' to 'Download CSV' (primary) and add secondary 'Queue export' for async jobs. Tooltip: 'Download all visible rows as CSV'.
Theo: Backend constraints: sync export limit ~5k rows; >5k should create an export job (we return job_id). Client should show progress: polling endpoint /exports/{id}.
Marta: A11y checklist: aria-label on main button = 'Download vectors as CSV'. Live region should announce 'Export queued' then 'Export ready'. Keyboard: allow Enter/Space to trigger primary, and allow Shift+Arrow to multi-select rows.
Alex: Vectors column: show collapsed preview like '[0.12, -0.03, ...]'. Clicking expands in a modal with full array. Also show dim in header: 'Vector (768d)'.
Priya: Relevance column: rename to 'Relevance (0-1)'. Default show 3 decimals; hover tooltip shows full score. Add a mini heat indicator bar for quick scanning.
Jo: Batch input placeholder copy: 'Paste text lines or upload CSV (column: text). For reranking use column: query, candidate_text'. Add small help link: 'Formatting tips'.
Theo: Note on precision: UI rounds to 3 decimals but CSV must contain full precision floats. We'll pipe the original vector floats to the export.
Marta: Contrast note: toolbar icons on dark theme fail WCAG AA when disabled. Current contrast ~3.5:1. Need >=4.5:1 for small icons or add backgrounds.
Alex: Sorting: clicking relevance header toggles asc/desc and highlights top N. Maybe add 'show top 10' quick action.
Priya: UX microcopy: cell overflow should show 'Show full vector' action, not 'Expand'. 'Expand' is ambiguous.
Jo: For selection UX, add a sticky action bar on scroll with selected count + 'Download selection' CTA. Also 'Clear selection' link.
Theo: Export CSV columns proposal: id, text, vector_768, relevance_score, source_file. Confirm?
Marta: Agree. Also aria-live message when download completes: include filename and link. If emailed, include 'You will receive an email when ready'.
Alex: Small keyboard nav: Left/Right move between table controls; Up/Down traverse rows; pressing 'v' focuses vector cell for quick expand.
Priya: For reranking preview we should show original rank + new rank delta. Column: 'Rank →' with small arrow. Also allow toggling between raw scores / normalized (0-1).
Jo: Edge case: CSVs with >1M rows should error early in client with suggested alternatives (use Dedicated or run offline).
Marta: I'll run the a11y pass after mocks update. Please add aria-describedby on help links.
ux-bot: uploaded file: vector_preview_export_v3.png
